structure.title: Preliminary Pages
structure.description: Introductory pages before the main body.

subsections.title: Title Page
subsections.guidance_notes: Project title, student's full name, matriculation number, degree in view, department/faculty, and month/year of submission.

subsections.title: Certification
subsections.guidance_notes: A statement certifying the originality of the work, signed by the student and the supervisor.

subsections.title: Dedication
subsections.guidance_notes: A short dedication of the work.

subsections.title: Acknowledgements
subsections.guidance_notes: Appreciation to those who contributed to the study.

subsections.title: Table of Contents
subsections.guidance_notes: List of chapters, sections, and sub-sections with their corresponding page numbers.

subsections.title: List of Tables
subsections.guidance_notes: Titles and page numbers of all tables in the work.

subsections.title: List of Figures
subsections.guidance_notes: Titles and page numbers of all figures/illustrations.

subsections.title: Abstract
subsections.guidance_notes: A concise summary of the entire research (Background, Objective, Methodology, Findings, and Conclusion), usually not exceeding 350 words.

structure.title: Chapter 1: Introduction
structure.description: Sets the foundation for the research.

subsections.title: Background to the Study
subsections.guidance_notes: Contextualizing the research problem.

subsections.title: Statement of the Problem
subsections.guidance_notes: Clearly defining the gap or issue being investigated.

subsections.title: Purpose of the Study
subsections.guidance_notes: General and specific objectives.

subsections.title: Research Questions
subsections.guidance_notes: Key questions the research aims to answer.

subsections.title: Research Hypotheses
subsections.guidance_notes: Tested statements (if applicable).

subsections.title: Significance of the Study
subsections.guidance_notes: Theoretical and practical importance.

subsections.title: Scope of the Study
subsections.guidance_notes: Delimitation in terms of coverage and depth.

subsections.title: Operational Definition of Terms
subsections.guidance_notes: Definitions of keywords as used in the study.

structure.title: Chapter 2: Literature Review
structure.description: Analysis of existing literature and frameworks.

subsections.title: Conceptual Framework
subsections.guidance_notes: Definition and explanation of core concepts.

subsections.title: Theoretical Framework
subsections.guidance_notes: Theories that support the research.

subsections.title: Empirical Review
subsections.guidance_notes: Review of previous related studies.

subsections.title: Summary of Literature Review
subsections.guidance_notes: Highlighting the research gap.

subsections.title: Research Design
subsections.guidance_notes: The overall strategy (e.g., Survey, Experimental, Case Study).

subsections.title: Population of the Study
subsections.guidance_notes: The target group for the research.

subsections.title: Sample Size and Sampling Technique
subsections.guidance_notes: How the sample was selected.

subsections.title: Research Instrument
subsections.guidance_notes: Tools used for data collection (e.g., Questionnaire).

subsections.title: Validity of the Instrument
subsections.guidance_notes: How the tool's accuracy was ensured.

subsections.title: Reliability of the Instrument
subsections.guidance_notes: How the tool's consistency was checked.

subsections.title: Method of Data Collection
subsections.guidance_notes: The procedure for gathering data.

subsections.title: Method of Data Analysis
subsections.guidance_notes: Statistical or qualitative tools used.

structure.title: Chapter 4: Data Analysis, Results and Discussion

subsections.title: Presentation of Data
subsections.guidance_notes: Using tables, charts, or graphs.

subsections.title: Analysis of Results
subsections.guidance_notes: Detailed interpretation of the data.

subsections.title: Discussion of Findings
subsections.guidance_notes: Connecting results to existing literature and theory.

subsections.title: Summary of Findings
subsections.guidance_notes: A recap of the major results.

subsections.title: Conclusion
subsections.guidance_notes: Overall inference from the study.

subsections.title: Recommendations
subsections.guidance_notes: Suggestions for policy or practice.

subsections.title: Suggestions for Further Studies
subsections.guidance_notes: Areas for future research.

subsections.title: Contribution to Knowledge
subsections.guidance_notes: How the study adds to the field (especially for Postgraduate).

subsections.title: Font and Spacing
subsections.guidance_notes: Times New Roman. 12pt (Body), 14pt (Sub-headings), 16pt (Chapter Titles). 2.0 (Double spacing) throughout the main body.

subsections.title: Margins and Alignment
subsections.guidance_notes: Left: 1.5 inches; Right, Top, Bottom: 1.0 inch. Justified alignment.

subsections.title: Referencing
subsections.guidance_notes: APA (American Psychological Association) Style, usually the latest edition.
